result.summary: 本文提出 Movie Gen，一组媒体生成基础模型，可生成 1080p 高清视频及同步音频，并支持指令式视频编辑和基于用户图像的人物个性化视频生成 [abstract]。其最大视频生成模型为 30B 参数 Transformer，最大上下文长度 73K 视频 token，对应 16 秒、16 FPS 的生成视频 [abstract]。模型在文本到视频、视频个性化、视频编辑、视频到音频和文本到音频等多个任务上取得新的最优结果 [abstract]。作者还公开了两个基准 Movie Gen Video Bench 和 Movie Gen Audio Bench，并详细给出架构、训练、推理与实验设置，希望加速媒体生成模型的研究 [S1.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文关注的核心科学挑战是让 AI 系统具备生成、组合和预测能力，并以图像、视频、音频作为输出空间 [S1.p1]。作者希望构建一组媒体生成基础模型，能够原生生成高保真图像、视频和音频，同时具备编辑和个性化视频的能力 [S1.p1]。此外，作者指出可靠地评测媒体生成模型很重要，因为仅能获得少量精选生成结果或缺乏模型与数据细节的黑盒系统会使可靠比较变得困难 [S8.p2]。

evidence.quote: Equipping AI systems with such generative, compositional, and prediction capabilities is a core scientific challenge with broad applications.
We present Movie Gen, a cast of media generation foundation models.
Movie Gen models can natively generate high fidelity images, video, and audio while also possessing the abilities to edit and personalize the videos
Reliable benchmarking of media generation models is important for identifying such shortcomings and for future research.
Having access to a few cherry picked generations or black box systems without clear details on model or data makes reliable comparisons hard.

method.text: Movie Gen 使用两个基础模型：30B 参数的 Movie Gen Video 用于联合文本到图像和文本到视频生成，13B 参数的 Movie Gen Audio 用于视频和文本到音频生成 [S2.p2]。作者发现，对使用 Flow Matching 训练的简单 Transformer 模型扩展训练数据、计算量和模型参数，可以得到高质量的图像、视频或音频生成模型 [S1.p2]。视频模型采用基于 LLaMa3 的 Transformer 骨干，并做了三处修改：加入跨注意力文本条件、加入自适应层归一化以引入时间步、使用全双向注意力 [S3.SS1.SSS3.p3]。个性化通过后训练实现，编辑能力则通过多阶段训练逐步减少训练与测试差异，且不依赖监督式视频编辑数据 [S2.p3][S5.p1]。

evidence.quote: We achieve these wide capabilities using two foundation models: • Movie Gen Video.
A 30B parameter foundation model for joint text-to-image and text-to-video generation
Movie Gen Audio. A 13B parameter foundation model for video- and text-to-audio generation
We find that scaling the training data, compute, and model parameters of a simple Transformer-based model trained with Flow Matching yields high quality generative models for video or audio.
We build our Transformer backbone by closely following the Transformer block used in the LLaMa3 architecture.
We make three changes to the LLaMa3 Transformer block for our use case of video generation using Flow Matching
We add video personalization and video editing capabilities to our foundation Movie Gen Video model via post-training procedures
we introduce Movie Gen Edit, a model that achieves state-of-the-art results in video editing, and outline our approach for training it without any supervised video editing data.

experiments.text: 文本到视频评测使用人工成对 A/B 测试，并公开包含 1003 条提示的 Movie Gen Video Bench，该基准比先前工作使用的提示集大 3 倍以上 [S3.SS5.SSS2.p1]。作者将 Movie Gen Video 与 Runway Gen3、LumaLabs、Kling1.5 和 OpenAI Sora 比较，其中对 Sora 使用其公开示例提示和视频，并手动从 Movie Gen Video 的五个生成选项中选一个以公平比较 [S3.SS6.SSS1.p1]。音频评测使用 VGGSound、OpenAI Sora、Runway Gen3 以及新提出的包含 527 个视频的 Movie Gen Audio Bench，并与 Diff-Foley、FoleyCraft、VTA-LDM、Seeing&Hearing、PikaLabs、ElevenLabs 等基线比较 [S6.SS3.SSS2.p3][S6.SS4.SSS1.p2]。视频编辑在 TGVE+ 和新提出的 Movie Gen Edit Bench 上评测，后者验证集 64 个视频、测试集 128 个视频 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p2][S5.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: we publicly release a benchmark, Movie Gen Video Bench
which consists of 1003 prompts that cover all the different testing aspects summarized above
Our benchmark is more than $3\times$ larger than the prompt sets used in prior work for evaluation.
This includes the black-box commercial models that offer API access through their website: Runway Gen3, LumaLabs, Kling1.5.
we compare to OpenAI Sora by methodically manually choosing one video from five generated options from Movie Gen Video for each prompt.
This includes VGGSound, OpenAI Sora, Runway Gen3, and our proposed Movie Gen Audio Bench.
It includes 527 videos and is designed to cover various ambient environments
We first compare Movie Gen Audio with 4 open-sourced models (Diff-Foley, FoleyCraft, VTA-LDM, Seeing&Hearing) and 2 blackbox commercial models (PikaLabs, ElevenLabs)
the benchmark validation set has 64 videos, whereas the test set has 128 videos.
We evaluate the capabilities of our model against two main video editing benchmarks.

findings.text: 在文本到视频整体质量上，Movie Gen Video 以 35.02% 的净胜率显著优于 Runway Gen3，并显著优于 LumaLabs；对 OpenAI Sora 取得 8.23% 的中等净胜，与 Kling1.5 的 3.87% 表现相当 [S3.SS6.SSS1.p2]。在真实感和美学上，Movie Gen Video 显著优于 Runway Gen3、LumaLabs 和 Kling1.5，对 Sora 在真实感上取得 11.62% 的显著净胜 [S3.SS6.SSS1.p3]。个性化模型在所有身份保持、视频质量和文本对齐指标上大幅优于 ID-Animator [S4.SS5.p1]。Movie Gen Edit 在 TGVE+ 上整体人工评测中被偏好程度比当前最优 EVE 高 74% [S5.SS3.SSS1.p4]。Movie Gen Audio 在同步、正确性和整体质量上大幅优于所有基线 [S6.SS4.SSS1.p3]。

evidence.quote: On overall quality, Movie Gen Video strongly outperforms Runway Gen3 (35.02%) and LumaLabs with the net win rate beyond $2\sigma$.
Our generations moderately net win over OpenAI Sora (8.23%) (net win rate within 1-2 $\sigma$) and are on par with Kling1.5 (3.87%).
Movie Gen Video significantly outperforms Runway Gen3, LumaLabs and Kling1.5 on both metrics, with 48.49%, 61.83% and 37.09% net win rates on realness, respectively.
Compared to OpenAI Sora, Movie Gen Video has a significant win on realness with 11.62% net win rate beyond $2\sigma$
our method significantly outperforms the baseline by a large margin in all axes of identity preservation, video quality, and text alignment.
On the TGVE+ benchmark, our model is preferred 74% more often than the current state-of-the-art EVE in the overall Human evaluation criterion.

Movie Gen Audio outperforms all baselines on all metrics by a large margin: with 33.8% to 72.8% on synchronization, 27.5% to 82.2% on correctness for all videos, and 31.3% to 91.0% on overall quality for generated videos.

limitations.text: 作者指出，视频生成模型在复杂几何、物体操作、物体物理、状态变换等方面仍存在生成或编辑伪影 [S8.p2]。生成音频在运动密集、视觉上较小或被遮挡、以及需要更细粒度视觉理解时有时会不同步，并且由于设计选择目前不支持语音生成 [S8.p2]。作者还指出，使用人工评测定义客观标准仍然困难，人工评测可能受个人偏见、背景等因素影响 [S8.p2]。此外，视频和音频模型是分别训练的，开发能联合生成这些模态的模型是重要的研究方向 [S8.p2]。

evidence.quote: we observe that video generation models still suffer from issues – artifacts in generated or edited videos around complex geometry, manipulation of objects, object physics, state transformations etc.
Generated audio is sometimes out of synchronization when motions are dense ( e.g., tap dance), visually small or occluded ( e.g., footsteps), or when it requires finer-grained visual understanding
It currently does not support voice generation either due to our design choices.

defining objective criteria evaluating model generations using human evaluations remains challenging and thus human evaluations can be influenced by a number of other factors such as personal biases, backgrounds etc.
While our models are trained separately for video and audio generation, developing models that can generate these modalities jointly is an important area of research.
